name: World Bank Indicators API

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Specifies the country code or 'all' for all countries. Valid values include country codes (e.g., 'BR' for Brazil) or 'all' to get data for all countries.

parameters.name: indicator
parameters.description: Specifies the indicator code (e.g., 'SP.POP.TOTL' for total population). Valid values are the codes of the indicators available in the World Bank database.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Specifies the format of the response. Valid values include 'json' (default), 'xml', 'csv', etc.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Specifies the date range for the data. Can be a single year (e.g., '2000'), a range (e.g., '2000:2001'), a month range (e.g., '2012M01:2012M08'), a quarter range (e.g., '2013Q1:2013Q4'), or year-to-date (e.g., 'YTD:2013').

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Specifies the page number for paginated results.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Specifies the number of results per page.

parameters.name: mrv
parameters.description: Specifies the number of most recent values to fetch.

parameters.name: mrnev
parameters.description: Specifies the number of most recent non-empty values to fetch.

parameters.name: gapfill
parameters.description: Specifies whether to fill missing values by backtracking to the next available period. Valid values: 'Y' or 'N'.

parameters.name: frequency
parameters.description: Specifies the frequency of the data. Valid values: 'Q' (quarterly), 'M' (monthly), 'Y' (yearly).

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: The source ID to filter indicators from a specific source. Example: '11'.

parameters.name: downloadformat
parameters.description: Specifies the download format. Valid values: 'csv', 'xml', 'excel'.

parameters.name: footnote
parameters.description: Specifies whether to include footnote details. Valid value: 'y' (for yes).

parameters.name: prefix
parameters.description: Specifies the prefix for JSONP responses. Required when 'format=jsonP' is used.

quirks_and_warnings: Version 1 of the API was officially retired in November 2018 and discontinued entirely on June 19, 2020. Accessing older endpoints will return a 'Resource not found' error.
You cannot currently sort any requests
A maximum of 60 indicators can be used
A maximum of 1,500 characters are allowed between two back-slashes (/)
A maximum of 4,000 characters are allowed in the entire URL
Translated local language country and region names are not available for all countries
Uses ISO 2 country codes (e.g., 'br' for Brazil)
Returns ISO codes when available; otherwise returns WB codes
